title: Remove the model runtime, worker, dependencies and their state
goal: No on-device model code, worker, wasm asset or dependency is left (no dead code)
acceptance: src/app/services/model.service.ts and src/app/services/runanywhere.ts are deleted; src/workers/vlm-worker.ts, src/app/services/workers/vlm-worker.js and public/workers/vlm-worker.js are deleted
package.json drops @runanywhere/web, @runanywhere/web-llamacpp, @runanywhere/web-onnx and the build:worker script; package-lock.json regenerated

angular.json drops the node_modules/@runanywhere/web-llamacpp/wasm asset; public/wasm/ is deleted; the dev-server Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy / Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy headers are removed only if nothing else needs them (checked and stated in F-023)
Any stored model state (cached model files, settings keys) the app wrote is named and either cleaned up on first run or stated as browser cache only
The production bundle size before and after is recorded in F-023
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
Something outside the assistant and demo that still needs the runtime goes to the owner, not removed silently

effort.basis: Two services, three worker files, three dependencies, a wasm asset and possibly the dev headers; the header check and model-state cleanup add uncertainty. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
